privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: In plain language — what data ihona.tj uses and how we handle it.
privacy.s1_body: On registration — your name and email. If you book a viewing or submit a property inquiry, the request details are shared with the agency that listed the property — that's the whole point of booking.
privacy.s2_body: Used to keep you signed in and for general anonymous traffic stats. You can disable them in your browser settings — on the site itself, this may limit some features, like signing in.
privacy.s3_body: Write to {email} and you can view, change, or delete your data at any time.
privacy.s4_body: We may update this page from time to time — the current version is always here.
privacy.disclaimer: This is a short, plain-language description of our practices, not a legal document — for official matters, consult a lawyer.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using ihona.tj, you agree to the terms below.
terms.s1_body: ihona.tj is a platform for listing and finding real estate in Tajikistan: sale, long-term rental, and short-term (daily) rental.
terms.s2_body: You're responsible for keeping your account password safe and for everything done under your account.
terms.s3_body: Property reviews are checked before publishing. We may reject or remove a review that contains abuse, false claims, or spam.
terms.s4_body: Property information is provided by the listing agency. The site does not guarantee its accuracy, completeness, or currency, and recommends verifying details in person before a viewing or transaction.
terms.s5_body: Booking a viewing or submitting a price offer through the site is informational only and does not constitute a sale or rental contract.
terms.s6_body: You may not post knowingly false reviews, use the site for fraud or spam, or attempt unauthorized access to other users' data.
terms.s7_body: The site is not responsible for disputes between buyers, tenants, and agencies arising from transactions conducted outside the platform.
terms.s8_body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Tajikistan.
terms.s9_body: We may update these terms from time to time. The current version is always available on this page.
terms.disclaimer: This document is a plain-language description of the site's usage rules and doesn't replace legal advice for compliance with a specific jurisdiction's requirements.
